summary: BoothIQ MVP first pass — comprehensive backend + frontend testing of admin, kiosk, wheel, and dashboard flows. All 34 backend pytest cases PASS (100%). End-to-end web flow verified: launcher → login (admin/staff) → admin (all 5 tabs load) → kiosk 3-step form → submit navigates to /wheel/:id → SPIN produces prize code (LQ4XRD in test) → staff dashboard shows lead cards with tiers, counters (spins, prizes left, tier bands), filters (state=TX reduced 6→5), and CSV/XLSX export both work. The CRITICAL kiosk-privacy rule holds: POST /api/kiosk/leads returns exactly {id, spin_available} — no tier/score/medicare/dollar fields leak; GET /api/kiosk/config exposes only labels/colors (no weight/inventory or medicare). Second spin on the same lead correctly returns already_spun. Admin guard verified: staff token → 403 on /api/admin/*. NPI checksum validation (Luhn over 80840+first9) works. Seed sample creates 700 physicians and goes live.

issues: Console: React hydration warning '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' — appears to come from Emergent's ve-dynamic dev overlay wrappers on <option> children in filter selects, not app source. Cosmetic/dev-only; will not appear in production build. If it does surface in prod, wrap option label in a plain string (already is).

WebSocket wss://.../api/ws/dashboard warning: 'closed before connection established' seen once during navigation — likely a page transition race. Live-push may briefly miss events; verify in a longer session.

action_items: Optional: investigate the transient WebSocket dashboard reconnect warning to ensure live lead push is reliable across long staff sessions.

Optional: for TX-seeded 'Amit Patel' (25 collisions), the kiosk lead currently resolves to GREY. That is by design (>=5 collisions => unresolved), but if you want to demo a matched high-value tier, capture a unique-name seeded physician (or use a valid NPI from the seeded 700) — a single-collision name from the seeded dataset would exercise the matched-tier scoring path.
critical_code_review_comments: Duplicate _seed_user block is fine, but consider async database index creation once at startup (already done). LGTM.

routes_admin.upload_chunk writes chunks appending in file order but does not verify index order — a client uploading out-of-order chunks could corrupt the CSV. Enforce sequential index or reject out-of-order chunks.

_dispatch_alerts computes 'recent' count but does not itself increment or dedupe within the loop; if two leads fire in the same second the ceiling can be exceeded slightly. Not a correctness bug for MVP.
kiosk/leads has no rate limiting or captcha — kiosk is trusted but a device_id spoof could DoS. Consider a per-device_id throttle post-MVP.
spin_wheel returns HTTP 200 even for error cases ({error: ...}) — consider 409 for already_spun so clients can react on status alone.
seed_data_creation: POST /api/admin/seed-sample creates 700 synthetic physicians (with intentional Lee/John, Patel/Amit, Ahmed/Syed name collisions) and marks the session LIVE. Verified via /api/admin/live physician_count=700.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest suite lives at /app/backend/tests/test_boothiq_api.py (34 tests). It seeds data via POST /api/admin/seed-sample so all downstream tests work standalone. Kiosk privacy assertions check both the response keys AND scan the body string for forbidden tokens. If you re-run and see stale TEST_ sessions in dashboard, that's expected (no autocleanup on sessions collection).
rca of the issue: No blocking issues found. Only very minor console warnings (React hydration inside dev overlay wrappers, transient WS reconnect) — both classified as low-priority.
